answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The horizon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the voyage of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vault re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
